scope: Existing captured Homebrew recipes, receipts, cached API and OCI evidence; no current Homebrew source or source archives were fetched
exact_identity_scope: Recipe/API/OCI and public-manifest bodies are byte-identical to saved captures. Receipt bodies use the earlier public capture's user-home/Homebrew-prefix normalization with every changed field recorded, and must not be described as raw byte-identical receipts.

privacy_scan.retained_public_build_path: Generic upstream /home/linuxbrew build metadata is public bottle provenance, not a local user path
